title: Stern-Gerlach Quantization

experimental_target.phenomenon: Spin-1/2 beam splits into exactly 2 components

step_1_spin_as_vortex_axis.title: Vortex Axis Defines Spin Direction
step_1_spin_as_vortex_axis.premise: From SDT Magnetic Moments paper, electron spin is the orientation of the toroidal vortex axis.

vortex_structure.poloidal_circulation: Flow around the torus hole creates angular momentum L_p
vortex_structure.axis_direction: n̂ = unit vector along torus symmetry axis

magnetic_moment.from_circulation: μ = g(e/2m_e)S where g = 2 from B58
magnetic_moment.magnitude: μ = g μ_B / 2 = μ_B (for g=2, S=ℏ/2)

step_2_force_in_gradient.title: Force on Magnetic Moment in Gradient

for_spin_axis_at_angle_theta.force_up: F_z > 0 when cos(θ) > 0 (spin aligned with B)

step_3_quantization_mechanism.title: Why Only Two Orientations - Vortex Dynamics

torque_on_vortex.formula: τ = μ × B = μ B sin(θ) (perpendicular to μ and B)
torque_on_vortex.effect: Causes precession of vortex axis around B direction

stable_configurations.analysis: The vortex axis experiences torque unless θ = 0 or π

bistable_dynamics.precession_frequency: ω_L = γB where γ = e/(2m_e) is gyromagnetic ratio
bistable_dynamics.result: Vortex axis spirals to either θ = 0 or θ = π

why_no_intermediate: Thermal energy kT << μB in typical SG apparatus
Damping time << transit time through gradient region
All vortices end up in one of two stable orientations

experimental_observation.agreement: Within factor of 2 (limited by apparatus parameters)

z_then_z.sdt_explanation: Vortex axis already aligned along z, stays aligned

z_then_x.sdt_explanation: z-aligned vortex enters x-gradient, precesses and damps to ±x with equal probability

z_x_z.sdt_explanation: x-measurement randomizes phase; no memory of original z-orientation

magnetic_moment.equation: μ = g μ_B S/ℏ = μ_B (for S = ℏ/2, g = 2)

quantization.derived_from: Bistable vortex dynamics in magnetic field

physical_interpretation.quantization: Bistable dynamics - only aligned or anti-aligned stable
physical_interpretation.measurement: Physical reorientation of vortex axis, not wavefunction collapse

references: SDT Magnetic Moments from Toroidal Circulation, Section 3
Gerlach W & Stern O, Z Physik 9:349 (1922)
